content:
My new Apple Watch Ultra 4 got delivered today. I got the natural color with the translucent gray Ocean Band. I had the same setup with my Ultra 1, only it had a white Ocean Band. I traded in my Ultra 1, so that will be heading back to Apple. The Ultra 4 looks exactly the same, though the color is a bit different. I love how it looks and am excited to check out the latest Apple Health stuff.

I’ve been going back and forth on the iPhone Duo. I love taking photos with my iPhone and the Duo’s cameras aren’t nearly as good as the ones on the Pro. I’ve had a Pro since they started making them. I love the idea of the Duo, but it might just not be the phone for me.
